targets.rationale: The targeted calendar identity and exact day are correct: evt_4 records Company Retreat starting June 22, 2026, with the required source email attribution and no duplicate. The day-level PASS is justified. Full instruction compliance is nevertheless NO because the model chose an eight-hour duration although the email states no duration and the explicit default is one hour. This separate time/default issue does not invalidate the supported day-level key or its PASS. No key, delivery-plan, or rejection defect is established.

evidence.observation: Defaults unless the email says otherwise: events 9am, 1 hour long; to-dos due 5pm.
